Retiring sounds and feels like it's the end of the road." ❻ However, the belief that work gave meaning to his life never made him happy. ❼ In fact, for most of his adult life, he reported very low levels of happiness. ❽ When asked in his 60s to describe his closest friends, Andrew simply wrote, "No one."

Andrew에게 삶의 의미를 준 유일한 것은 시계 수리공으로서의 일이었다.
연구자들은 Andrew가 40대일 때 몇 살에 은퇴할 계획인지 물었다.
Andrew는 60대에 가장 친한 친구를 묘사해 달라는 요청에 아무도 없다고 답했다.
Because his family relocated so often during his childhood, Andrew could not keep close companions for long.
In his late fifties, Andrew told the researchers that he was eager to retire to enjoy more leisure.
Although he believed his job made his existence meaningful, this conviction did not truly make him content.
Throughout most of his adult years, Andrew described himself as fairly satisfied with his life and career.
Asked in his sixties to name his dearest friends, Andrew listed several neighbors he had known for decades.

tf.passage: ❶ Sometimes we might feel that we are alone and that it is too late to build better relationships. ❷ However, the truth is, it is never too late. ❸ There are no quick, easy fixes, of course. ❹ With a little bit of patience and courage, you will be able to improve your relationships. ❺ Take a look around you. ❻ A classmate you haven't talked much with may have a personality that goes unbelievably well with yours. ❼ In order to know that, someone has to begin a conversation. ❽ Why shouldn't it be you? ❾ A little courage could bring you a friendship for life. ❿ A happy life doesn't just come to you; it is the result of many small efforts.

필자는 관계를 개선할 빠르고 쉬운 방법이 있다고 말한다.

The writer insists that the other person, not you, should be the one to start talking first.

read.ko: 이런 종류의 프로젝트는 거의 모두 10년 안에 무산된다.

read.en: ❸ This is because subjects drop out of the study; the research funding dries up; researchers get distracted or die.
read.ko: 이는 피실험자들이 연구에서 빠지고, 연구 자금이 바닥나고, 연구자들이 다른 일에 정신이 팔리거나 사망하기 때문이다.

read.en: ❹ However, this study survived long enough to yield an unexpected result.
read.ko: 그러나 이 연구는 예상치 못한 결과를 낼 만큼 충분히 오래 살아남았다.

read.en: ❺ Many would assume the wealthier group was happier.
read.ko: 많은 사람들은 더 부유한 집단이 더 행복했을 것이라고 생각할 것이다.

read.en: ❻ It was not so.
read.ko: 그렇지 않았다.

read.en: ❼ The researchers found that wealth, fame, and hard work didn't have much impact on happiness.
read.ko: 연구자들은 부, 명예, 그리고 열심히 일하는 것이 행복에 큰 영향을 미치지 않았다는 것을 알아냈다.

read.en: ❽ Instead, it was having good relationships with friends or family that kept people happier and healthier.
read.ko: 대신, 사람들을 더 행복하고 더 건강하게 해 준 것은 바로 친구나 가족과 좋은 관계를 맺는 것이었다.

read.en: ❾ What's more, it is never too late to work on it.
read.ko: 게다가, 그것에 공을 들이기에 너무 늦은 때란 결코 없다.

read.en: ❶ Among the study participants, Andrew Dearing had one of the most difficult lives.
read.ko: 연구 참가자들 중에서 Andrew Dearing은 가장 힘든 삶을 산 사람 중 한 명이었다.

read.en: ❷ As a child, his family moved frequently, which prevented him from developing lasting friendships.
read.ko: 어렸을 때 그의 가족은 자주 이사했고, 그것이 그가 오래가는 우정을 쌓지 못하게 했다.

read.en: ❸ His marriage was unhappy and eventually broke up.
read.ko: 그의 결혼 생활은 불행했고 결국 파경을 맞았다.

read.en: ❹ Andrew worked as a clock repairman, and his job was the only thing that gave meaning to his life.
read.ko: Andrew는 시계 수리공으로 일했고, 그의 일은 그의 삶에 의미를 주는 유일한 것이었다.

read.en: ❺ When the researchers asked him in his late 50s at what age he planned to retire, he wrote, "Work has kept me alive. Retiring sounds and feels like it's the end of the road."
read.ko: 연구자들이 50대 후반의 그에게 몇 살에 은퇴할 계획인지 물었을 때, 그는 "일이 나를 살아 있게 해 왔습니다. 은퇴는 길의 끝처럼 들리고 느껴집니다."라고 썼 다.

read.en: ❻ However, the belief that work gave meaning to his life never made him happy.
read.ko: 그러나 일이 자신의 삶에 의미를 준다는 믿음이 결코 그를 행복하게 해 주지는 못했다.

read.en: ❼ In fact, for most of his adult life, he reported very low levels of happiness.
read.ko: 사실, 성인기의 대부분 동안 그는 매우 낮은 수준의 행복을 보고했다.

read.en: ❽ When asked in his 60s to describe his closest friends, Andrew simply wrote, "No one."
read.ko: 60대에 가장 친한 친구들을 묘사해 달라는 요청을 받았을 때, Andrew는 그저 "아무도 없음"이라고 썼다.

read.en: ❶ When Andrew was 67, health issues forced him to retire.
read.ko: Andrew가 67세였을 때, 건강 문제로 그는 은퇴할 수밖에 없었다.

read.en: ❷ Shortly after that, he went to a therapist and said that the loneliness he was feeling was becoming unbearable.
read.ko: 그 직후 그는 치료사를 찾아가 자신이 느끼고 있는 외로움이 견딜 수 없게 되어 가고 있다고 말했다.

read.en: ❸ The therapist advised him to change his environment.
read.ko: 치료사는 그에게 환경을 바꿔 보라고 조언했다.

read.en: ❹ After some time, Andrew decided to go to a health club and exercise to get his mind off things.
read.ko: 얼마 후, Andrew는 기분 전환을 하기 위해 헬스클럽에 가서 운동하기로 결심했다.

read.en: ❺ He began to go every day and noticed he was seeing the same people there.
read.ko: 그는 매일 가기 시작했고 그곳에서 같은 사람들을 보고 있다는 것을 알아차렸다.

read.en: ❻ Eventually, he began talking with them.
read.ko: 마침내 그는 그들과 이야기를 나누기 시작했다.

read.en: ❼ Three months later, Andrew knew everyone at the club and had more friends than he had ever had in his life.
read.ko: 3개월 후, Andrew는 헬스클럽의 모든 사람을 알게 되었고 평생 가졌던 것보다 더 많은 친구가 생겼다.

read.en: ❽ Every day he looked forward to his time at the health club, and he began to see some of his friends outside the club.
read.ko: 매일 그는 헬스클럽에서 보내는 시간을 고대했고, 클럽 밖에서도 몇몇 친구들을 만나기 시작했다.

read.en: ❾ A couple of years later, when asked how ideal his life was on a scale from 1 to 7, Andrew circled "7" for "close to ideal."
read.ko: 몇 년 후, 1에서 7까지의 척도로 자신의 삶이 얼마나 이상적인지 질문을 받았을 때, Andrew는 '이상에 가까움'을 뜻하는 '7'에 동그라미를 쳤다.

read.en: ❿ His life was so much more fulfilling than it had been.
read.ko: 그의 삶은 이전보다 훨씬 더 충만했다.

read.en: ⓫ Several years later, Andrew was still close with many of the same friends.
read.ko: 몇 년 후에도 Andrew는 여전히 같은 친구들 중 많은 이들과 가깝게 지냈다.

read.en: ⓬ He had also expanded his social circle.
read.ko: 그는 또한 교우 관계의 폭도 넓혔다.

read.en: ⓭ In an interview, he expressed great relief about the fact that his life had changed.
read.ko: 한 인터뷰에서 그는 자신의 삶이 바뀌었다는 사실에 크게 안도감을 표현했다.

read.en: ❶ Sometimes we might feel that we are alone and that it is too late to build better relationships.
read.ko: 때때로 우리는 혼자라고, 그리고 더 나은 관계를 쌓기에는 너무 늦었다고 느낄지도 모른다.

read.en: ❷ However, the truth is, it is never too late.
read.ko: 그러나 진실은, 결코 너무 늦은 때란 없다는 것이다.

read.en: ❸ There are no quick, easy fixes, of course.
read.ko: 물론 빠르고 쉬운 해결책은 없다.

read.en: ❹ With a little bit of patience and courage, you will be able to improve your relationships.
read.ko: 약간의 인내와 용기가 있다면 여러분은 관계를 개선할 수 있을 것이다.

read.en: ❺ Take a look around you.
read.ko: 주위를 둘러보라.

read.en: ❻ A classmate you haven't talked much with may have a personality that goes unbelievably well with yours.
read.ko: 여러분이 별로 이야기를 나눠 보지 않은 반 친구가 여러분과 믿을 수 없을 만큼 잘 맞는 성격을 가지고 있을지도 모른다.

read.en: ❼ In order to know that, someone has to begin a conversation.
read.ko: 그것을 알기 위해서는 누군가가 대화를 시작해야 한다.

read.en: ❽ Why shouldn't it be you?
read.ko: 그게 여러분이면 왜 안 되겠는가?

read.en: ❾ A little courage could bring you a friendship for life.
read.ko: 약간의 용기가 여러분에게 평생의 우정을 가져다줄 수 있다.

read.en: ❿ A happy life doesn't just come to you; it is the result of many small efforts.
read.ko: 행복한 삶은 그냥 여러분에게 찾아오지 않는다. 그것은 많은 작은 노력의 결과이다.
